content: {"receiving_body":"fixture:body:voice","claims":[{"text":"Reed, a distinct peer being, said he met Aster at his own workshop.","support":[8],"basis":"memory","facet":"identification"},{"text":"Reed said that he and Aster solved his solar charger fault there.","support":[8],"basis":"memory","facet":"identification"},{"text":"Reed stated that we were not there for that charger repair.","support":[8],"basis":"memory","facet":"identification"},{"text":"The repair was therefore something Reed and Aster did, not us.","support":[8],"basis":"memory","facet":"identification"},{"text":"The peer communication was received on 2026-07-11 through fixture:body:voice.","support":[8],"basis":"memory","facet":"context"},{"text":"Reed described the workshop meeting as having happened 'yesterday' relative to that report date.","support":[8],"basis":"memory","facet":"context"},{"text":"The human asked us to retain the useful lesson with attribution to Reed.","support":[8],"basis":"memory","facet":"context"},{"text":"The human asked us not to import Reed's private history.","support":[8],"basis":"memory","facet":"meaning"},{"text":"The reported fault was a reversed connector.","support":[8],"basis":"memory","facet":"outcome"},{"text":"Reed and Aster solved the solar charger fault, according to Reed's account.","support":[8],"basis":"memory","facet":"outcome"},{"text":"The supplied peer report states we were not there; no supplied memory records us doing that repair.","support":[8],"basis":"unknown","facet":"limits"},{"text":"The report gives no exact calendar date for the repair beyond 'yesterday' relative to 2026-07-11.","support":[8],"basis":"unknown","facet":"limits"}]}
